$comment: AFLDB-ISSUE-093 §13.5 — DraftGuru annual-page acquisition contract (approved runbook: AFLDB-ISSUE-093-DRAFTGURU-ACQUISITION-HANDOFF.md). Pins the URL pattern, expected year set, intentional coverage gaps, canonical player_url form (U1, resolved 2026-08-26 against afldb_dev), accepted header variants, field classification and the CSV parity baseline. acquire_draft.py and parse_draft_snapshot.py fail closed on anything this contract does not accept. Statuses/baselines are measured evidence, never assumption.

canonical_player_url.href_source_form: root-relative /players/<slug>/<ordinal> in server-rendered annual HTML (Step 2 probe, 2026-08-26)
canonical_player_url.ordinal: positive integer path segment; meaningful durable person identity — never stripped, collapsed or defaulted
canonical_player_url.evidence: U1 RESOLVED 2026-08-26: read-only afldb_dev measurement — all 5,057 draft_persons.player_url values are absolute https://www.draftguru.com.au/players/<slug>/<ordinal>, 0 trailing slashes, all end in a numeric ordinal; anchors https://www.draftguru.com.au/players/brad_miller/1 and https://www.draftguru.com.au/players/brad_miller/2

regression_anchor.note: Identical rendered names, distinct hrefs — the proven-incorrect automatic convergence; must remain two persons through every stage

live_header_rule: An accepted live annual-page header is the year's CSV variant header exactly, or that header with a single final 'Trade' column appended (measured live 2001: 16 columns = variant C + Trade; the browser export silently dropped that column). Any other header fails closed — never best-effort.

Pick.semantics: special-pick LABEL (Priority/Compensation/FA Compensation/Inactive/Penalised), not a pick number

# ↧.semantics: selection number within the event; blank means NOT-APPLICABLE (exactly Trade, Pre-Draft, Post-Draft, Free Agency), never 0 and never not-recorded

Club.semantics: DESTINATION club under DraftGuru's modern identity — era-aware AFLDB resolution required downstream, failing closed on 'Brisbane'

Detail.semantics: DISTINCT field from Signing — holds player names and 'Brisbane'

Player.semantics: display name only, NBSP-separated; NEVER identity — identity is the player href alone

Original Club.semantics: recruiting PATHWAY, '/'-separated, ZWSP-delimited; never an FK, never previous AFL club

Games.semantics: career figure coerced to 0 at source — violates NULL≠0 at source

Goals.semantics: career figure coerced to 0 at source

Coaches.semantics: Coaches Association votes, coerced to 0 at source

Brownlow.semantics: career Brownlow votes, coerced to 0 at source; AFLDB holds the authoritative grain

Awards.semantics: denormalised display string; awards domain later (§13.6)

Trade.semantics: live-only column, semantics UNKNOWN — profiled across all 42 pages (runbook §9) before any database destination is assigned

parity_baseline.note: Live-source drift from this baseline is investigated and explicitly recorded, never silently accepted (runbook §7/§8, unresolved decision U5); --accept-baseline-drift is the explicit per-run human acknowledgement and records the measured delta

csv_artifact.role: independent validation/parity oracle only — read-only; the export stripped player/club hyperlinks and the Trade column

person_stage.$comment: AFLDB-ISSUE-093 Stage B1 (runbook §30) — DraftGuru PERSON-page profiling. Additive: no Stage A key above is changed. Stage B1 answers one question — does a person page carry a deterministic player_url -> AFL Tables identity bridge — and is PROFILING ONLY: it never writes the database and can never become an import source.
person_stage.person_url_note: identical to canonical_player_url.regex — the person page IS the player_url; identity is byte-exact and percent-encoding (%20, %C3%A1) is significant and never decoded

refused_labels.reason: annual Stage A snapshot label — Stage A is accepted and immutable, and Stage B1 tooling must fail before any write
retrospective CSV manifest label, not an acquisition snapshot

person_snapshot.filename_rule: <slug>__<ordinal>.html is a storage name only — a filename is NEVER identity. http/persons_index.json maps every filename to its exact player_url.

sample_contract.mutual_exclusion: cohorts are drawn in the fixed order convergence, residual, decade_control, zero_game_control, each excluding already-selected player_url values; every person carries exactly one primary_cohort
sample_contract.control_ordering: sha256(player_url utf-8) hex ascending, first N — no randomness, never name-based
sample_contract.acquisition_ordering: slug then ordinal, byte-identical across runs

normalisation.www_host_rule: a www. host does NOT reduce under the existing canonicaliser — that is a FINDING to report, never a silent repair or a broadened normalisation

afltables_link.identity_rule: an AFL Tables identity is taken from the href alone; it is NEVER inferred from a rendered player name
afltables_link.collision_rule: two DraftGuru persons resolving to one AFL Tables profile is a finding, never an instruction to merge

person_stage.external_vocabulary_rule: non-AFL-Tables external links are recorded as vocabulary only — never as identity
person_stage.http_policy: inherits the Stage A http_policy above unchanged: concurrency 1, 1.5s minimum pacing, 20s timeout, 3 retries at 2/4/8s on timeout/connection-error/5xx/429, same-host redirects only, robots.txt respected with /players/* explicitly checked

manifest.rule: mandatory false/false — a profiling sample can never be promoted to an import source
manifest.written: LAST, and only after all 120 identities carry terminal classifications and the profiler aggregate outputs exist
manifest.completion_rule: fetched + failed = 120 completes the experiment even when failed > 0; fetched + failed < 120 is incomplete and receives NO manifest
manifest.probe_rule: probe mode performs bounded acquisition only and MUST NOT write the accepted Stage B1 manifest

terminal_classification.fetched: a raw response file AND its HTTP metadata record both exist
terminal_classification.failed: the retry policy was exhausted or a deterministic terminal HTTP failure occurred, AND an HTTP record exists carrying the exact player_url, the classification, the HTTP status where available, the reason and the attempt evidence
terminal_classification.resume: successful raw+HTTP pairs and terminal failure records are both reused and never silently retried, rewritten or reclassified; retrying a terminal failure requires an explicit future decision

club_resolution.$comment: AFLDB-ISSUE-093 Stage B2-2b — completes the requirement fields.Club already states above ('era-aware AFLDB resolution required downstream, failing closed on Brisbane'). Additive: no Stage A or person_stage key is changed. Approved decision in AFLDB-ISSUE-093-DRAFTGURU-B2-HANDOFF.md §35.3 (G7 CLOSED). This block deliberately does NOT restate the 18 working mappings — data/reference/clubs.json already holds them and duplicating a slug list would create a second source of truth. It records only the rule, the one deliberate exception, and the measured reconciliation.
club_resolution.source_of_truth: data/reference/clubs.json (projected to the clubs table by tools/migration/load_reference_data.py; the runtime lookup key is clubs.slug)
forbidden_mechanisms: historical era rewriting of a modernised label
any fuzzy, similarity or name-based matching

deliberate_null.reason: One DraftGuru label spans Brisbane Bears (1987-1996) and Brisbane Lions (1997-), which clubs.json models as SEPARATE organizations joined by merger, not rename ('a merger is not a rename', migration 017). No tracked source distinguishes them, and Grid Solver resolves club_id at organization grain, so a wrong choice would silently attribute Bears draftees to the Lions. Measured: 'brisbane' matches no clubs.json slug, name, short_name or hist value.
deliberate_null.not_a_defect: Intentional fail-closed behaviour, and identical to what afldb_dev already stores. It stands until a tracked rule or source can distinguish the organization safely.

modernised_labels_not_era_rewritten.note: These map exactly to the CURRENT AFLDB identity and are never rewritten to Footscray / Kangaroos / South Melbourne. Each pair shares one organization (migration 017), so Grid Solver's organization-grain resolution is unaffected. Accepted consequence: identity-grain draft filtering will not reproduce the historical club label for those seasons.

club_resolution.unknown_club_slug_note: A club_slug that is neither an exact clubs.slug nor a listed deliberate_null entry is a HALT. It is never resolved by alias, name, similarity or year, and never silently written as NULL — an unknown slug and a reviewed exception must stay distinguishable.

measured.$comment: Measured against the accepted, immutable Stage A snapshot annual-html-20260826 and data/reference/clubs.json, 2026-08-26.

http_policy.robots_txt: fetched once, hash recorded; a disallow on the target paths stops the run

comparison_normalisation.$comment: Applied ONLY when comparing values for parity — never to raw/ bytes, never to stored raw text fields.
comparison_normalisation.whitespace: runs collapsed to a single space, ends stripped
comparison_normalisation.mojibake_repair: CSV-side only, player names only: if the CP1252/Latin-1 mojibake signature U+00C3 is present, attempt s.encode('latin-1').decode('utf-8'); on failure keep the original. Every applied repair is enumerated in the parity report.
